title: Trieu Tien Episode 26: Jia Academy Trial by Combat
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling
tone: Heroic, melancholic, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: Xiao Yan returned from the Dou Di battleground to find a Jia Academy summons awaiting him — a trial by combat against his own teacher. He had no choice: refuse and the entire Mo clan would be destroyed.
concept.story_arc: Summons received → Mo clan threatened → Entering Jia Academy → Teacher appears → Combat demanded
concept.emotion: Determination → Fear → Dread → Resolve → Battle begins

shots.prompt: Close-up — a JIA ACADEMY ENVELOPE lands on the Mo clan's gate. Red wax seal, Jia Academy insignia. Inside: a combat summons for Xiao Yan — mandatory, no exceptions. Mo clan's elders' faces turn pale. Camera: close-up, Jia Academy envelope, red wax seal, elders' pale faces, 'summons received' tension moment. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — Jia Academy envelope, red wax seal, elders' pale faces, mandatory summons, 6s
shots.narration: The Jia Academy did not summon students for combat trials. It summoned threats. Enemies. People who needed to be eliminated quietly, with the Academy's full legal authority. And Xiao Yan had just received one.
shots.sfx: Envelope landing, elders pale, ominous music, tension drums, dread strings

shots.prompt: Close-up — the letter reads aloud: 'Xiao Yan must face TRIAL BY COMBAT against his Jia Academy teacher. Refusal means the destruction of the Mo clan under academic law.' Xiao Yan's hands tighten. Camera: close-up, letter text, Xiao Yan's hands tightening, 'Mo clan destruction' threat, 'refusal consequence' dread moment. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — letter text, hands tightening, Mo clan destruction threat, dread expression, 6s
shots.narration: Trial by combat. The oldest law in the Jia Academy — and the cruelest. If he refused, the Academy would legally dissolve the Mo clan. Every member. Every elder. Every child. And if he fought, he would face the teacher who had trained him.
shots.sfx: Letter read, threat confirmed, hands tightening, ominous orchestral, dread strings

shots.prompt: Wide cinematic — Xiao Yan walks through the JIA ACADEMY GATES alone. Students part before him. The grand courtyard — once a place of learning — is now a combat arena. Banners of rival sects line the walls. Camera: wide, Jia Academy gates, students parting, grand courtyard combat arena, rival sect banners, 'entering academy' moment. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — academy gates, students parting, grand courtyard combat arena, rival sect banners, 6s
shots.narration: The Jia Academy. Where he had trained. Where he had grown. Where he had learned that power was the only language the world understood. And now it wanted him to fight his own teacher on its stage.
shots.sfx: Academy gates, students parting, combat arena, rival banners, ominous orchestral

shots.prompt: Wide — XIAO YUAN emerges from the opposite gate. His teacher. His mentor. The man who had guided his early dou qi training. He is in full combat regalia — Dou Huang rank, his eyes cold. 'I taught you everything,' he says. 'Today I see if you learned anything worth killing.' Camera: wide, Xiao Yuan emerging in full combat regalia, Dou Huang teacher, cold eyes, 'taught you everything' ominous greeting, 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — Xiao Yuan emerging, full combat regalia, Dou Huang teacher, cold eyes, ominous greeting, 6s
shots.narration: Xiao Yuan had been his teacher — kind, wise, patient. The man who had recognized Xiao Yan's talent and pushed him harder than anyone else. And now he stood in full battle armor, ready to kill his own student.
shots.sfx: Teacher emerging, cold eyes, combat regalia, ominous greeting, tension drums

shots.prompt: Close-up — Xiao Yan's hand moves to his chest where the Flame Ember Signet burns. He looks at his teacher — the man who had believed in him — and makes his choice. 'Forgive me, teacher,' he says quietly, and ignites. Camera: close-up, hand over Flame Ember Signet, 'forgive me teacher' moment, igniting, resolve expression, 'combat begins' moment. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — hand over signet, 'forgive me teacher', igniting, resolve expression, combat begins, 6s
shots.narration: There was no choice. Refuse and the Mo clan died. Fight and his teacher — the one person who had believed in him — had to die first. Xiao Yan had learned long ago that the world did not give fair options.
shots.sfx: Ignition, 'forgive me', resolve music, combat beginning, epic orchestral swell

audio.narration: The Jia Academy did not summon students for combat trials. It summoned threats. Enemies. People who needed to be eliminated quietly, with the Academy's full legal authority. And Xiao Yan had just received one. Trial by combat. The oldest law in the Jia Academy — and the cruelest. If he refused, the Academy would legally dissolve the Mo clan. Every member. Every elder. Every child. And if he fought, he would face the teacher who had trained him. The Jia Academy. Where he had trained. Where he had grown. Where he had learned that power was the only language the world understood. And now it wanted him to fight his own teacher on its stage. Xiao Yuan had been his teacher — kind, wise, patient. The man who had recognized Xiao Yan's talent and pushed him harder than anyone else. And now he stood in full battle armor, ready to kill his own student. There was no choice. Refuse and the Mo clan died. Fight and his teacher — the one person who had believed in him — had to die first. Xiao Yan had learned long ago that the world did not give fair options.
audio.bg_music: Epic Chinese battle orchestral, flame emperor theme, Jia Academy atmosphere, dou qi combat, 95-100 BPM

Episode 26 of Trieu Tien. Xiao Yan receives a mandatory Jia Academy summons — trial by combat against his own teacher Xiao Yuan. Refusal means the Mo clan's destruction. He enters the arena to face the man who trained him.
